## Summary

Update `bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json` to match the test vectors in the bitcoin/bips repository at commit `04393c98`.

This update includes:
- The corrected input encodings from the BIP 352 vectors (`04393c98`), without changing any expected results.
- The new Taproot annex test case (`3c68d3f3`), which covers an annex-removal error not caught by the previous vectors in Bitcoin Core's C++ tests.

No test code has been modified. Only the test vector file has been updated.

## Testing

Tested on macOS 27.2.1, Apple M3.

- C++: `bip352_tests` passed.
- Python: `test_framework.bip352` passed.

Both test suites were run before and after updating the vectors.
